concerns.quote: The evidence established that the collision between Mr Kusiak and a motor vehicle occurred on an unlit dual carriageway subject to the national speed limit that runs alongside a housing estate and an industrial estate in Belmont. It is foreseeable that pedestrians will attempt to cross the road.

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that an unlit stretch of road subject to the national speed limit creates a risk because pedestrians cannot be seen far enough ahead for vehicles to stop safely.
